gold_sql:
WITH p1 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.006345 40.747055)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-74.006345 40.747055)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
),
p2 AS (
  SELECT ST_Value(d.rast, 1, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.944251 40.728028)',4326)) AS elev
  FROM public.dem_us d
  WHERE ST_Intersects(d.rast, ST_GeomFromText('POINT (-73.944251 40.728028)',4326))
  LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
  ABS(p1.elev - p2.elev) AS elevation_difference_m,
  p1.elev AS poi1_elevation_m,
  p2.elev AS poi2_elevation_m
FROM p1, p2;
